'''Thon Larimhor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] a frequent patron of the [[Cantina Oceana]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Dorumaa]]. He hired [[Rysko Barnt]] to pose as [[Kalani (individual)|Kalani's]] ex-boyfriend to provoke [[Echari Di'San]] into attacking Barnt. He then killed Barnt to have Di'San framed for his murder. Larimhor was Kalani's actual boyfriend and had used her in similar schemes before.
